metadata.label: Leaf 3.2.8 Thermal Track optimizations - ten-thermal bench sweep
metadata.coverage_notes: User reports about ten seconds on Thermal Track and at least a few seconds on each other primary page; 37.361 s exported duration. Ten fixed synthetic markers in Thermal Track, including markers under distance labels; outlined text labels. Developer capture stopped and exported before SD retrieval. BLE setting enabled; actual client activity not established.
metadata.sd_card: Connected Leaf SD card; model/capacity not recorded
metadata.limitations: Short exploratory bench capture, 8-25 normal renders per page. Not a release assessment. Prior screenshot is runtime_2.json (schema 2), while this capture is schema 3; firmware, workload, duration, sensor/GPS conditions and GPS arrival phase are not controlled between the runs. Reported earlier/newer page values are descriptive, not a formal matched-baseline comparison.
metadata.flashed_firmware_verified: USB I:/FIRMWARE.BIN SHA256 matches the test-build firmware exactly

notes: Normal slot/page statistics exclude held buttons, button events and recovery. Recovery covers the next two dispatched slots and extends while completion is late or start delay exceeds 1 ms; inspect it separately.
Few samples: the least-sampled slot has 29; tail estimates are preliminary.

GPS summaries include all sentence dispatches, including interactions. Stages are exclusive elapsed times on device (host thread CPU in sim), not isolated CPU costs. UART timestamps observe firmware reads, not wire arrival. Checksum acceptance does not establish a valid position fix.
Recent trace wrapped by design; full-run slot aggregates and the worst incident remain available.
Clock-pair, slot-bookkeeping, and memory-sampling costs are reported. Full instrumentation overhead requires an external A/B measurement.
A zero stack reading can mean an unregistered task or no headroom; inspect active task state and raw samples. Positive stack minima skip zero readings.
Stage 1 manual capture: enabled features are not verified workload coverage. Review is required before release.
Memory change is between manual capture endpoints; a negative change alone does not prove a leak. Heap low watermarks include earlier boot activity.
ATTENTION: internal free heap ended below its starting value; repeat equivalent lifecycle phases to assess recovery.
ATTENTION: barometer first-call delay exceeded 1 ms in slots 97. Check conversion timing.
ATTENTION: button recovery includes deadline crossings, coalesced ticks or barometer delays. Button exclusions do not establish safe recovery; check sensor/GPS/IGC continuity on hardware.
